mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.title, b.author, b.price, i.available_quantity AS stock FROM books b JOIN inventories i ON i.book_id = b.id WHERE b.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.author LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY b.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM books WHERE title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR author LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
SELECT b.id, b.title, b.author, b.price, i.available_quantity AS stock FROM books b JOIN inventories i ON i.book_id = b.id WHERE b.id = #{id}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO books (title, author, price, stock) VALUES (#{book.title}, #{book.author}, #{book.price}, #{book.stock})
